project.title: Branch Queue & Service Experience Optimization Pilot
project.objective: Reduce in-branch wait times and improve customer experience by redesigning queue processes, triage, and cross-channel handoffs for a pilot branch network.
deliverables: Current-state branch queue and service mapping
Redesigned queue and triage process for teller and service desks
Call centre triage and callback playbook
Cross-sell and information script for frontline staff
Operational performance dashboard for pilot branches
Pilot rollout and training report with recommendations
constraints: Pilot must run within existing branch opening hours and staffing levels
All changes must comply with banking regulations and internal audit requirements
No new core banking system; only configuration and process changes allowed
Customer data handling must follow data protection and privacy policies
Pilot must not increase average transaction handling time at teller windows
Any physical layout changes must be low-cost and reversible

risks.risk: Queue changes confuse customers and temporarily increase complaints.
risks.mitigation: Use clear signage, staff guidance, and a short customer-facing FAQ; monitor complaints daily and adjust scripts.

risks.risk: Staff resist new triage and scripting, reverting to old habits.
risks.mitigation: Involve staff in design, run short training sessions, and collect feedback in week 1 and 2 for quick tweaks.

risks.risk: Process changes inadvertently breach internal controls or segregation of duties.
risks.mitigation: Have compliance and internal control review all new flows and approvals before pilot launch.

risks.risk: Call centre cannot absorb additional triage or callback workload.
risks.mitigation: Limit pilot volume, define caps per day, and create overflow rules back to branches.

risks.risk: Data for the performance dashboard is incomplete or inconsistent across branches.
risks.mitigation: Standardise simple logging templates and run a 2-day data capture test before full pilot.

themes.why_relevant: Core to reducing wait times and balancing teller vs service workloads.
Enables moving non-urgent issues off the branch floor while keeping service quality.
Consistent, clear messaging reduces confusion and complaints during changes.
Banking processes must remain compliant while changing workflows.
Needed to judge pilot success and refine processes quickly.
Must improve experience without turning interactions into hard-sell moments.

backlog.task: Map current branch queue, transaction types, and average wait times for pilot branches
definition_of_done: At least two full days of observations logged per pilot branch
List of top 10 transaction types with approximate volumes created
Average and peak wait times estimated for teller and service queues
Summary shared with operations manager and call centre agent

backlog.task: Design new triage flow separating quick transactions from complex service requests
definition_of_done: Draft triage flow diagram created and reviewed with two bank tellers
Compliance confirms no control breaches in proposed flow
Simple decision checklist for frontline staff written
Flow approved for pilot by branch operations manager

backlog.task: Create call centre triage and callback playbook for branch referrals
definition_of_done: List of issues suitable for call centre handling agreed with operations manager
Standard callback script drafted for at least five common scenarios
Escalation rules and SLAs documented
Playbook shared with pilot call centre team and acknowledged

backlog.task: Develop customer-facing explanation script for new queue process
definition_of_done: Short greeting and explanation script drafted for lobby use
Script tested informally with at least three colleagues for clarity
Compliance reviews script for regulatory wording
Final version printed and shared with all pilot branch staff

backlog.task: Set up simple daily log for wait times, complaints, and redirected cases
definition_of_done: Paper or digital log template created and agreed with operations manager
Staff briefed on how to record entries consistently
Test run completed for one day with sample data
Template adjusted based on feedback and locked for pilot

backlog.task: Train pilot branch staff on new triage, scripts, and logging
definition_of_done: Training agenda and materials prepared
At least 90% of pilot staff attend a session or receive 1:1 briefing
Attendance recorded and questions captured
Follow-up FAQ shared in writing after training

backlog.task: Define light cross-sell and information prompts for quick transactions
definition_of_done: List of 3–5 suitable prompts aligned with key products created
Prompts kept under 20 seconds to avoid extending queues
Compliance and product teams review and approve prompts
Prompts integrated into teller and call centre scripts

backlog.task: Monitor first week of pilot and collect staff feedback on issues
definition_of_done: Daily check-in notes captured for each pilot branch
Top 5 recurring issues identified and prioritised
Quick fixes agreed with tellers and call centre
Summary shared with stakeholders at end of week 1

backlog.task: Adjust call centre staffing schedule to cover new callback demand
definition_of_done: Estimate of expected daily callback volume produced
Proposed shift tweaks documented and shared with supervisor
No breach of maximum working hours or break rules
Schedule changes approved and communicated to team

backlog.task: Prepare pilot performance dashboard with key indicators
definition_of_done: Metrics defined (wait time, complaints, callbacks, redirected cases)
Data sources mapped to each metric
Simple weekly dashboard template created
Stakeholders agree on format and review cadence

backlog.task: Document compliance and control checks for new processes
definition_of_done: List of control points in old vs new process drafted
Compliance feedback incorporated into final checklist
Checklist shared with all pilot branches
Evidence storage approach agreed (e.g., logs, sign-offs)

backlog.task: Compile final pilot report with recommendations for wider rollout
definition_of_done: Before/after metrics summarised for all pilot branches
Staff and customer feedback themes included
Clear go/no-go and improvement recommendations listed
Report circulated to senior stakeholders and archived

threads_plan.thread_goal: Align on current-state mapping and confirm scope of the pilot branches.
threads_plan.trigger: Operations manager posts initial project brief and asks for confirmation of current issues and data gaps.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Agree on which branches and service areas are included in the pilot scope.
Confirm the minimum data set to capture for current-state mapping.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Design and finalise the new triage and queue process for the pilot.
threads_plan.trigger: Draft triage flow and checklist are shared for feedback and compliance considerations.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Approve the triage decision rules for quick vs complex transactions.
Decide how to handle edge cases that do not clearly fit quick or complex categories.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Define scripts and communication for customers and cross-sell prompts.
threads_plan.trigger: Commercial sales representative posts first version of customer explanation and cross-sell scripts.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Select the final customer-facing explanation script for use in branches.
Agree on which cross-sell prompts are allowed during quick transactions.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Set up call centre triage, callbacks, and staffing adjustments.
threads_plan.trigger: Call centre agent shares draft playbook and proposed schedule changes for callbacks.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Approve the call centre triage and callback playbook for the pilot.
Confirm the adjusted staffing schedule to support pilot callbacks.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Monitor pilot progress, review metrics, and agree on final recommendations.
threads_plan.trigger: Operations manager posts first week dashboard and feedback summary for discussion.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Reconfirm or adjust pilot scope based on early results.
Revisit triage rules if metrics or feedback show issues.

channel_rituals: Daily async check-in during pilot with quick update on queues and issues
Twice-weekly metrics post with short commentary from operations manager
Weekly feedback round-up from tellers and call centre on what to adjust
Pre-pilot readiness checklist review before go-live
Post-pilot retrospective discussion to capture lessons learned
